answer: Arrival-latency knoll scoring: each new identity must accumulate a first-hour traffic shape matching organic signup—sparse early bursts rising on a slow glacier curve. Agents fitting a smooth spiral of steadily growing request intervals earn standing; those arriving in tight synchronized clusters get throttled to one action per five minutes. An attacker farming N clones pays N × the real-time dwell to fake organic pacing, since parallel spawning collapses into flagged bursts.
